items.title: AI agents should browse your site, not call your API
items.raw_excerpt: We compared four architectures for putting AI agents on websites — RAG bots, API-tool agents(WebMCP), code-writing sandboxes (Cloudflare Agent Lee), and DOM-native execution. Three of them force you to maintain a parallel engineering surface. The DOM already has live state, user auth, and permissions baked in. A structural breakdown of why.

title_i18n.en: AI agents should browse your site, not call your API
title_i18n.zh: AI代理应浏览您的网站，而非调用您的API。
title_i18n.es: Los agentes de IA deberían navegar por tu sitio, no llamar a tu API.

excerpt_i18n.en: We compared four architectures for putting AI agents on websites — RAG bots, API-tool agents(WebMCP), code-writing sandboxes (Cloudflare Agent Lee), and DOM-native execution. Three of them force you to maintain a parallel engineering surface. The DOM already has live state, user auth, and permissions baked in. A structural breakdown of why.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 我们比较了四种在网站上部署AI智能体的架构——RAG机器人、API工具智能体（WebMCP）、代码编写沙箱（Cloudflare Agent Lee）以及原生DOM执行。其中三种架构要求维护一个并行系统。
excerpt_i18n.es: Comparamos cuatro arquitecturas para implementar agentes de IA en sitios web: bots RAG, agentes con herramientas API (WebMCP), entornos de ejecución de código escrito (Cloudflare Agent Lee) y ejecución nativa en el DOM. Tres de ellas obligan a mantener una infraestructura paralela.

items.title: AI Subroutines – Run automation scripts inside your browser tab
items.raw_excerpt: We built AI Subroutines in rtrvr.ai. Record a browser task once, save it as a callable tool, replay it at: zero token cost, zero LLM inference delay, and zero mistakes. The subroutine itself is a deterministic script composed of discovered network calls hitting the site's backend as well as page interactions like click/type/find. The key architectural decision: the script executes inside the webpage itself, not through a proxy, not in a headless worker, not out of process. The script dispatches requests from the tab's execution context, so auth, CSRF, TLS session, and signed headers get added to all requests and propagate for free. items.title: AI 驱动的数据库心脏：如何让云原生「自我进化」
items.raw_excerpt: 在数字化转型的浪潮下，企业对数据库的需求正在发生深刻变革：弹性的极致、性能的极限、成本的极致压缩。今天，我们将深度解析腾讯云自研的云原生数据库 TDSQL-C，通过与 Serverless、AI 技术的深度融合，引领云端数据库的智能化变革，并为不同行业的复杂业务场景提供坚实的技术底座。

title_i18n.zh: AI 驱动的数据库心脏：如何让云原生「自我进化」
title_i18n.en: AI-Driven Database Core: How to Enable Cloud-Native Self-Evolution
title_i18n.es: Corazón de base de datos impulsado por IA: cómo lograr que la nube nativa «evolucione por sí misma»

excerpt_i18n.zh: 在数字化转型的浪潮下，企业对数据库的需求正在发生深刻变革：弹性的极致、性能的极限、成本的极致压缩。今天，我们将深度解析腾讯云自研的云原生数据库 TDSQL-C，通过与 Serverless、AI 技术的深度融合，引领云端数据库的智能化变革，并为不同行业的复杂业务场景提供坚实的技术底座。
excerpt_i18n.en: Amid the wave of digital transformation, corporate demands for databases are undergoing profound changes: extreme elasticity, peak performance, and maximum cost compression. Today, we will delve into Tencent Cloud's self-developed cloud-native database TDSQL-C, which, through deep integration with Serverless and AI technologies, is leading the intelligent transformation of cloud databases and providing a robust technical foundation for complex business scenarios across various industries.
excerpt_i18n.es: Bajo la ola de transformación digital, las demandas empresariales hacia las bases de datos están experimentando cambios profundos: elasticidad extrema, rendimiento máximo y compresión radical de costes. Hoy, analizaremos en profundidad la base de datos nativa en la nube TDSQL-C, desarrollada por Tencent Cloud, que, mediante su integración profunda con tecnologías Serverless e IA, lidera la transformación inteligente de las bases de datos en la nube y proporciona una sólida base tecnológica para complejos escenarios empresariales en diversos sectores.
